title: TASK MATRIX cell output (stub) — proposed ProgramBench task candidates
description: LLM-emitted, schema-validated before the gate proceeds. The REAL contract is the pydantic TaskCandidate in src/programsmith/cells/task_matrix.py; this file is a provenance stub (ADR-0038 replaced the rewrite-port axes). Advisory recommendation; auto mode picks first recommended -> first viable (ADR-0039), human mode picks manually. <=10 candidates (10 is a MAX, not a quota — ADR-0033). One repo usually yields ONE task; candidates differ by flag-surface scope only when the tool is huge.

profile.description: rubric used to produce this matrix

no_candidate_reason.description: required by the pydantic contract when candidates is empty

source_evidence.description: Path-labelled locked-checkout facts supporting the decision. Fresh decisions require 2-8; zero remains valid only for legacy persisted matrices.

tool_name.description: binary name agents must reimplement (may differ from repo name)

binary_name.description: actual executable name (e.g. difft for difftastic)

flag_surface.description: which subcommands/flags the grader will exercise (the candidate's scope axis)

case_families.description: feature families the case suite must cover

est_kloc.description: estimated upstream kLOC; full and draft profiles apply different suitability floors

stdin_friendly.description: verifier pipes stdin; file-walking tools need files_dir cases instead

deterministic_output.description: under pinned flags if needed; hard requirement for byte-exact grading

expected_difficulty.description: target = Opus 4.8 pass@1 in [1/3, 2/3] at the 18000s budget (ADR-0040) — NOT 'frontier must fail'

expert_hours.description: estimated implementation hours for the active profile

basis_ref.description: the existing precedent/exemplar this candidate would wrap; REQUIRED non-empty (invariant #3)
